name: Chronos Trap in Time
description:
About This Game

Harness the power of the Gods and bring the Titans to their knees!

Chronos Trap in Time is a high-octane vertical rogue-like shooter that blends classic arcade action with deep, modern progression systems. As a champion of the Gods, you must ascend through shifting battlefields, overcoming mythical hordes to challenge the ancient Titans in a fast-paced quest for glory.

The Path to Olympus: Dual-Layer Progression

Victory isn't just about fast reflexes; it's about the choices you make between the heat of battle and the sanctity of the heavens.

  • In-Run Evolution: During each descent into chaos, collect sacred ingredients to brew temporary potions and gather immediate blessings. These provide the tactical edge needed to survive the current wave.

  • Eternal Divine Favors: Death is merely a gateway to greater power. Before each run, speak with the Gods to unlock permanent upgrades that stay with you forever.

Key Features:

  • God-Specific Mechas: Every Greek God grants you access to a unique Mecha tailored to their divine essence. Master Zeus’s lightning-infused machinery or the crushing tide of Poseidon’s steel.

  • Hephaestos’ Flaming Forge: Visit the God of Forge to upgrade your entire arsenal. These permanent enhancements affect all Mechas and weapons, ensuring that your firepower grows exponentially with every material you claim.

  • Tactical Weaponry: Beyond your Mecha's innate abilities, develop a specialized weapon kit. Customize your fire rate, damage patterns, and elemental effects to build the ultimate Titan-slaying machine.

  • Bullet-Hell Mythos: Engage in intense vertical combat against waves of mythical enemies. Experience smooth, responsive controls designed for precision dodging and dash-attacks.

  • Titan Showdowns: Face off against gargantuan bosses in multi-stage battles that will test the limits of your build and your skill.

Will you be the one to reshape the heavens? Prepare your Mecha, seek the blessings of the ancients, and begin your ascension.
short_desc: Harness the power of Greek Gods in this intense vertical rogue-like shooter. Command divine Mechas, brew sacred potions, and unlock permanent upgrades at Hephaestos’ Forge. Battle mythical hordes and challenge the Titans in a fast-paced quest for eternal glory!
